title: Validate Binary Search Tree
summary: Check that every node is larger than everything in its left subtree and smaller than everything in its right subtree.

tests.explain: Every left subtree holds smaller values and every right subtree larger ones, at every node.
Each node is ordered correctly against its own children, but 3 sits in the right subtree of 5 and is smaller than 5.
Values must be strictly smaller on the left and strictly larger on the right, so equal values break the rule.

hints: Comparing each node with its two children is not enough: a node must also respect its grandparent and every ancestor above.
Pass down the open range (low, high) that each node's value must lie in. The root gets (-Infinity, Infinity).

Going left, the node's value becomes the new high; going right, it becomes the new low. A value outside its range makes the tree invalid. (Equivalently, an in-order traversal must be strictly increasing.)

complexity.time: O(n): every node is checked once
